changes.comment: sdk-ui-pluggable-host: registerLocalHostUiModuleLoader registers a local host UI module, which takes precedence over the uiModule of the registry. A remote host UI module from a secured remote must pass the allowed-organizations and build-age checks, at load and on every context change, or the host uses its default UI. Host UI module failures reach onLoadFailed with the new host-ui module kind. create-pluggable-module can scaffold a host UI module.
